# Online activity of a blended course (AUTHORING.md, "Blended courses").
# Copy to courses/<slug>/week-WW/online-NN.qmd: Online activity NN, in the

# repeats the face-to-face lecture.
#
# THE LIGHT ONLINE ACTIVITY (Digital Skills from Online activity 4, the
# teacher's request of 2026-11-24; courses/digital-skills/NOTES.md, "The
# light online activity"). The teacher records a screen video in Arabic that
# goes through this page and solves it, so the page is short and practical:
# - 2-4 Steps marked {.study}: 2-4 short points (the words of the lecture),
#   then ONE simulator that looks like the real app (Word Lab, Excel Lab,
#   PowerPoint Lab, Access Lab, Forms Lab, Sites Lab) with the data of a
#   model, and at most one Try it (a .match with a "Why:"). No "On your own
#   computer" box, no ### parts, no long text: one Step is one page.
# - AI never in the tasks: a Step may show it on Tutu Lab (tutudocs.com,
#   "Only look and try here: the tasks do not need AI.").
# - Tasks to submit: ONLY QUESTIONS, answered in the tasks PDF (a form):
#   "Task 1 · Tap the answer" ({.pick}, 2-5 options, no [x]) and "Task 2 ·
#   Type the answer" (one word, one number, a name or a formula, with
#   {{< answer-space lines=1 >}}), 5-8 questions, at least 2 of each kind.
#   Every answer is on the page: a student who watches the video once can
#   answer them all. No file, no screenshot, no real app (the course project
#   may keep one file task: `project: true`).
# - The tasks PDF fits on one A4 page.
# check_size.py checks it (light_warnings). Model answers: courses-private,
# week-WW/online-NN-solutions.md.
title: "Short title from schedule.yml"
description: "Online activity · On simulators that look like the app: … Then short questions in the tasks PDF. About 30 minutes."
online: 4          # the number of the online activity
due: "before lecture 5"   # the next face-to-face lecture, never a week or a date
content: sims      # every Step has its simulator
tasks: questions   # the light online activity
ilos: [A3]
toc-title: "In this activity"
format: lesson-html

## Before you start {.study}

- **You need:** a phone or a computer with a browser. Nothing to install.
- **How it works:** watch the video of your teacher on the e-learning
  platform. Then do each Step on its simulator.
- **You submit:** the **tasks PDF** with your answers, before lecture 5.
  About 30 minutes.

- the third option

::: {.pick}

- another option

Answer in the **Tasks PDF to fill in**, save it, and upload it **before lecture 5**.
